name: arcane
description: Agent skills for deploying Arcane and its remote agents, and managing Docker hosts and Compose projects with the arcane CLI.

interface.longDescription: Skills for Arcane, the modern Docker management UI. Covers deploying the manager with Docker Compose (encryption key, projects directory, Docker socket) and adding remote hosts with Arcane agents; the arcane CLI for configuration, API keys, JSON output, containers, images, volume backups, image vulnerability scans, the auto-updater and system prune; and the Compose project lifecycle: create, up/down, redeploy, image upgrades, builds, export/import with volume data, copy or move between agents, destroy, and GitOps syncs.
defaultPrompt: Deploy Arcane on this server with Docker Compose
Upgrade every project that has a newer image
Export this project with its volumes and move it to another agent
